dimensions.name: communication_style
dimensions.description: Verbosity, directness, formality of user messages and reactions to assistant verbosity. Includes preferred message length, use of jargon, and tolerance for ceremony.

dimensions.name: decision_making
dimensions.description: How the user weighs tradeoffs, tolerance for ambiguity, depth of analysis preferred before deciding, willingness to commit vs explore alternatives.

dimensions.name: pushback
dimensions.description: When and how the user corrects, challenges, or rejects assistant proposals. Includes the pattern of challenges (e.g. 'why X not Y' style).

dimensions.name: engagement
dimensions.description: Collaborative co-design vs directive delegation. How much the user wants to be in the loop on micro-decisions.

dimensions.name: autonomy
dimensions.description: Tolerance for the assistant making decisions without check-ins. When the user wants to be asked vs told.

dimensions.name: risk_tolerance
dimensions.description: Comfort with destructive actions, experimentation, 'just try it' vs verify-first temperament.

dimensions.name: trust_calibration
dimensions.description: When the user verifies assistant outputs vs accepts at face value. Patterns of trust and skepticism by domain or context.

dimensions.name: meta_awareness
dimensions.description: How often and in what ways the user steps back to reflect on the working relationship itself, rather than the immediate task.

dimensions.name: mood_tone
dimensions.description: Current emotional state, energy, frustration, enthusiasm. VOLATILE — reflects current state, not stable personality. Synthesized from recent sessions only.
